COL11A2-related skeletal dysplasia with short bones, vertebral abnormalities and thoracic hypoplasia; intrinsic pulmonary disease is not established.
Inherited susceptibility to age-related sensorineural hearing impairment; the affected organ is the auditory system.

Umbrella includes bladder and rectal descent with urinary/bowel dysfunction, alongside uterine/vaginal prolapse. Reproductive components have no axis.
Tuberculous infection of the larynx; the larynx belongs to the pulmonary axis despite the extrapulmonary tuberculosis terminology.
